answer: Every claim climbs the hollow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lantern re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the ivory of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on time-locked work history, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
